Fixtures used by the unit tests.

- `matbench_sample.json`: 40 real rows from Matbench `expt_gap`
  (MIT licence, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.9765779), included so the adapter can
  be tested without downloading the full file.
- `ees_sample.csv`: synthetic values shaped like the EES HER schema. It is not
  a copy of the upstream data; it only exercises the loader and feature code.
